milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the agent starts with an empty inventory (no /give commands). Mining an oak_planks block drops the item into inventory. Having at least 1 oak_planks confirms the agent successfully broke a block from the oak plank wall at z+5. This is preferred over position_inside_box because the task is about obtaining a resource, not navigation.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted bowl ends up in the player's inventory and the agent starts with zero bowls. The bowl recipe requires 3 planks (any type) in a V-shape on a crafting table. Having at least 1 bowl confirms the agent successfully used a crafting table to craft it. This is the standard rule for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted dark_oak_trapdoor ends up in the player's inventory and the agent starts with zero trapdoors. The recipe requires 6 dark_oak_planks arranged in 2 rows of 3 on a crafting table, producing 2 trapdoors. Having at least 1 dark_oak_trapdoor confirms the agent mined dark oak planks from the wall at z-5 and successfully crafted the item. This is the standard rule for craft tasks.
